defs.def: that must be obeyed exactly 严格的（指必须恪守）

ex.s: If we want to reconstruct what was actually going on that day, the shield must be questioned and interpreted as deeply and strictly as the written reports.
ex.t: 如果我们想重建当天实际发生的事情,就必须对盾牌提出质疑,并把它解释为与书面报告一样深刻和严格。

ex.s: Strictly follow traditional recipes when cooking.
ex.t: 在烹饪时严格遵循传统食谱.

ex.s: She is a strict and smart teacher.
ex.t: 她是一个严格和聪明的老师。

ex.s: strict control over any suspicious customer
ex.t: * 严格控制任何可疑客户;

ex.s: Jenn Berman, author of The A to Z Guide to Raising Happy and Confident Kids, says, "We've gone to the opposite extreme of a few decades ago when parents tended to be more strict." By giving kids a lot of praise, parents think they're building their children's confidence, when, in fact, it may be just the opposite.
ex.t: "The Ato Z Guide to Lading Happy and Confident Kids"的作者简·伯曼(Jenn Berman)表示,"我们进入了几十年前父母往往更加严格的相反的极端",通过给孩子们很多赞美,父母认为他们在建立孩子的信心,而事实上,这可能正好相反.

ex.s: The teacher was very strict, 3________(make) me so nervous that I would forget my lines.
ex.t: 老师很严格, 3 (使)我如此紧张,

ex.s: I will no longer be able to 7_______________ as much as before if I have to follow a strict dorm schedule.
ex.t: 如果我不得不遵守严格的宿舍计划 我将无法再像以前那样 达到7点

ex.s: Ms Weaver was strict and spoke , but she was always encouraging and inspiring.
ex.t: Weaver女士很严格,说话很严谨,但她总是鼓励和鼓舞人心。

ex.s: SoFi Stadium requires you to park strictly in your assigned zone, and guests must enter through the exact gate indicated on their color-coded digital parking pass.
ex.t: 索菲体育场要求您严格在指定区停车,客人必须通过其彩色码数字停车证上标明的确切大门进入.

ex.s: We could also say English was created by people, not by computers, so it does not follow strict rules.
ex.t: 我们还可以说英语是由人而不是计算机创造的,所以它没有遵循严格的规则.

ex.s: They often do not follow strict grammar rules, because writers use as few words as possible to catch the attention of the readers.
ex.t: 他们往往不遵循严格的语法规则,因为作家尽可能少用词来吸引读者的注意.

defs.def: demanding that rules, especially rules about behaviour, should be obeyed 要求严格的；严厉的

ex.s: In my ninth-grade writing class last year, I met a cowboy who saved his town, a strict father who demanded his son earn straight A’s, and a modern-day Juliet who died of heartbreak after her parents rejected the love of her young life.
ex.t: 在去年九年级的写作班上,我遇到了一位拯救了小镇的牛仔,一位严格要求儿子挣得A的父王,以及一位现代朱丽叶,她的父母拒绝了她年轻时的爱情后,因心碎去世.

defs.def: obeying the rules of a particular religion, belief, etc. exactly 恪守教规（或信条等）的
very exact and clearly defined 严密的；严谨的；精确的
